contact.evidence_quote: STEP 3. After the mobility agreement is signed (with planned teaching / training activities has been signed), a scanned copy is to be sent to Erasmus+ Office of the UNWE, erasmus@unwe.bg + passport scan. Please note that the grant agreement that regulates the payment of the financial support towards the staff member and a few additional administrative requirements need to be regulated before arrival – the actual start of mobility/arrival should be planned minimum 3 months in advance.

contacts.rung: Institutional Erasmus+ coordinator. This office is the primary point of contact for Erasmus+ mobility arrangements at the university.
